formulaBlock.normalization: Aqua [Water] one entry; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Low (C6): no strong anionic anywhere; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the mild anionic Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate (2) with prominent amphoteric co-surfactants Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine (3) and Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Sulfosuccinate leads the system; still a mild class under C3.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate (bounded): several light routes: PEG-18 Glyceryl Oleate/Cocoate refatter (5), Avena Sativa (Oat) Peptide (8), Glycol Distearate (14), Polyquaternium-11 (17), Panthenol (7), Glycerin (22). C2 not met (no silicone or prominent payload lipid).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Polyquaternium-11 is a low-charge, fixative-type polymer listed late; all routes except the refatter are post-fragrance, so a cleansing-led low reading is realistic.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: deposition is light and late: one PEG glyceryl ester refatter, a peptide, a late Polyquaternium-11 and a trace C13-15 Alkane; no silicone, no oil or butter.

depositionLoad.rationale: Weak refatter (5), oat peptide (8), PQ-11 (17), C13-15 Alkane (21).

persistence.rationale: PQ-11 can film lightly; peptide and refatter weakly retained.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Only weak/late routes; reset is weak but there is little to reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: four families are listed, but the refatter is a weak PEG ester, the peptide and PQ-11 are post-fragrance (PQ-11 at 17, after citric acid), and the alkane is trace and light; no persistent silicone, oil or butter converges, so combined residue is unlikely to be noticeable.
weightPotential.limitingFactor: Weak reset means even light routes are not offset (neighbor moderate).

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Care-direction verdict provisional: nonspecific (peptide + panthenol + light polymer); mildness is not a focus.

usageRole.rationale: Default; frequent possible with explicit frequency wording.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: CSA formula half NOT met: no prominent E4 route (Panthenol 7 is post-fragrance). Prominent PEG-18 Glyceryl Oleate/Cocoate (5) is not on the closed E4 list: unlisted_route_candidate:PEG-18 Glyceryl Oleate/Cocoate.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole in the complete INCI.

formulaFacts.role: protein_film (not the listed Avena Sativa Kernel Extract/Flour)
